newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Servgro says in second phase of unbundling.
newsitem.headline: Servgro says in second phase of unbundling.

text.p: Servgro International Ltd said on Wednesday it was heavily involved in the second phase of its unbundling which it expected to be completed in the second half of 1997.

"The second phase of the unbundling will result in the distribution of Servgro's cash resources and any of its remaining investments or proceeds thereof," the company said in a statement accompanying its annual results.
The group's remaining major assets include Interleisure Ltd, Teljoy Holdings Ltd, Fedics Group Pty Ltd and Interpark Pty Ltd.
Following the unbundling Servgro may liquidate and delist.
The first phase of Servgro's unbundling included last month's listing of Avis Holdings Ltd on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
Servgro's sustainable share income for the year ended-March 31, leapt by 62 percent to 122.5 cents compared to 75.5 cents previously.
The group said it had decided not to declare a final dividend as a consequence of the first phase of unbundling, which was completed on April 7.
